limitations: Source-derived candidate; no local efficacy validation.
Only the declared communication-test and native HCCL source slices are normalized; inherited strategy guidance and its source identities remain unchanged.
Wrapper inspection does not qualify native HCCL/TorchNPU implementations, transport algorithms, numerical correctness, backend compatibility or measured gains.

Native source coverage is one selected multi-rank AICPU mesh one-shot AllReduce path at the HCCL pin; legacy device routes, other engines/collectives and HCOMM transport/runtime implementations are not qualified.
Inspected upstream tests use simulated task-graph semantics; neither those tests nor native numerical, memory, bandwidth, model-quality or service experiments were run.

applicability.scope: Select and diagnose Ascend parallel strategies and their activation/overlap, with a separately bounded native multi-rank HCCL AllReduce dispatch and correctness procedure.
applicability.input_contract: Installed collective/runtime builds, rank/device map and topology, workload/strategy settings, count/dtype/reduction, effective dispatch, per-rank outputs and completed-collective/application timing evidence.
applicability.produced_artifact: A topology- and workload-qualified strategy/dispatch diagnosis, activation and correctness checks, stage-cost attribution and a target-validation proposal; isolated test completion is not a service result.
applicability.failure_modes: Requested parallel settings can silently fall back; stale local-head/chunk/shard parameters can disable a path, and changed topology/card count can confound strategy comparisons.

recommendations: Confirm the final collective algorithm/engine after fallback and observe sharding/collective activation before interpreting correct outputs or tuning performance.
Preserve peer/thread waits and test distinct rank/position data with explicit completion on every rank; keep enqueue time, collective completion and application-stage timing separate.
Recompute topology-derived parameters and remeasure the anchor after changing card groups or parallel degree; inherited diffusion topology restrictions are not universal HCCL gates.
Require producer/consumer timeline and exposed-communication evidence for overlap; compare the real pipeline wait cost rather than extrapolating small collectives from bytes.
